description: Daily, checks the current Xero Payroll AU pay run for employees whose payroll hours don't match their approved timesheet (via get_hours_reconciliation). For each real variance found, looks up that client's correction policy (revert / next pay run / unscheduled pay run) from organisation Knowledge (Payroll/correction-policy.json, with optional per-employee overrides), and opens a WorkQ item with the full evidence (employee, pay run period, variance by earnings rate) and the policy that applies. Marking the item Done is the approval step. This automation only proposes -- it never changes anything in Xero. A companion automation, Corrections Workflow: Execute, picks up from there once an item is approved.
